QuestInfo.name: Forest Guardian
QuestInfo.0: Somchai the monk needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Somchai refuses to give up the search for Master Loong. He asked you to check in with #p9000075# the forest guard to see if he had any information, but #bMaster Loong's Rosary#k you had was stolen by Teeny White Monkeys! Recover Master Loong's belonging from #bTeeny White Monkey and Mean Mama Monkey#k, and bring it to #bChan#k the guard in the #rForest of Training 4#k.
QuestInfo.2: Somchai refuses to give up the search for Master Loong. You retrieved Master Loong's belonging from the #bTeeny White Monkeys and Mean Mama Monkeys#k and returned them to #bChan#k, the guard at #rForest of Training 4#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,298,960
Can proceed to the Loong Abandoned quest

0.0: If you came all the way out here to find me, then, like, you're going to help me and Noi, right?

yes.0: Awesoooome. If you head east, you'll find #b#p9000075# the guard#k in the #r#m252010300##k. Give him the #bclue#k that I found and, like, ask him if he knows anything.
yes.1: (Those #bmonkeys#k appear out of nowhere and pluck the clue out of Somchai's hands.)\n\nHeeeeey. Come back here, #bmonkeys#k! We need that clue... Drat, they're gone. But it looks like they're headed toward #r#m252010200##k.

no.0: I can't go back without my master. I know Noi's, like, frightened and stuff, but he'll be safe in the Golden Temple.

1.0: Unless you're prepared to grease my palm, you'd better scram. \r\n#L0##bSomchai sent me to ask you if you've seen his master.#l\n#k
1.1: Somchai? Somchai... No clue who that is. All those monks look alike.\r\n#L0# #bHere, he said this belongs to his master. Do you recognize it?#l\n#k
1.2: Sure. That belongs to #b#p9000073##k. He passed by not too long ago. I waved and smiled because it never hurts to be nice to the top dogs, but he walked right past me as if he didn't even see me. Jerk.

yes.0: Since this is lost property, I'll just hold on to it. It's real silk, you know.

npc.0: Recover the clue stolen by #b#o8144002##ks and #b#o8144003##ks  and bring it to #b#p9000075##k at the #r#m252010300##k. See if he knows anything about where master is.

item.0: Stop! This place is too dangerous for you. You should return to the Golden Temple. Of course, if you were to drop a few mesos, I would have to help pick them up, and no one would be guarding the path...\r\n\r\n#b(You need to recover Master Loong's Rosary from the Teeny White Monkey and Mean Mama Monkeys.)#k
